nodes.one_liner_zh: 构建目录、密钥、minified、包目录、FIFO——walk 前就挡下，各带原因
nodes.one_liner_en: Build dirs, secrets, minified code, bundles, FIFOs — blocked at walk time, each with a reason
nodes.professional_zh: walk 的目录层跳过：SKIP_FOLDERS（build/target/dist/out/.next，逐项注明生态）、隐藏目录不下钻、包目录（.app）、.noindex、TCC 不可读≠空；文件层跳过：密钥/证书、内容级 minified 与生成文件标记拒读、许可文件、超大小帽、FIFO 特殊文件。is_project_root 保护逻辑防止把项目本身误判成产物目录。每条跳过都记原因——跳过也是能力行，不是静默消失。
nodes.professional_en: Walk-time directory skips: SKIP_FOLDERS (build/target/dist/out/.next, each annotated with its ecosystem), hidden dirs not descended, bundle dirs (.app), .noindex, and TCC-unreadable ≠ empty. File-level skips: secrets/certs, content-level minified and generated-file markers, license files, size caps, FIFOs. is_project_root guards against misjudging a project as its own build output. Every skip records its reason — skipping is a capability row, not a silent vanish.
nodes.plain_zh: 进门前先看邀请名单：编译产物、密钥、压成一行的代码、安装包——每类都有挡驾理由，且理由可查。不是「没看见」，是「看见了、决定不读、原因在此」。
nodes.plain_en: A guest list at the door: build output, secrets, minified blobs, installers — each rejection carries its reason. Not 'didn't see it' but 'saw it, declined to read it, here's why'.
nodes.example_zh: status --failures 与能力行里能看到 unsupported 行的原因（如 'license file'、'minified'）。
nodes.example_en: status --failures and capability rows show unsupported reasons ('license file', 'minified').
code_refs: goldmine/ingest/walk.py — 目录/文件双层跳过
nodes.analogy_en: A guest list with printed reasons

nodes.one_liner_zh: 目录链永不跟随（防环），文件链跟到内容
nodes.one_liner_en: Directory symlinks never followed (cycle guard); file symlinks are read through
nodes.professional_zh: 目录符号链永不跟随——目录环（a→b→a）会让确定性 walk 变成无限循环；st_ino/st_dev 同时用于 walk 防环。文件符号链跟到内容：链本身不是内容，指向的文件才是。这是一对方向相反的决定，共同原则是「语义优先于字面」。
nodes.professional_en: Directory symlinks are never followed — a directory cycle (a→b→a) would turn a deterministic walk into an infinite one; st_ino/st_dev double as the walk's cycle guard. File symlinks are read through: the link isn't the content, the target is. Two opposite calls, one principle: semantics over literalism.
nodes.plain_zh: 指路的牌子不逛，牌子指到的店要进。不然两家店互相挂对方的牌子，你就在街上走到天黑。
nodes.plain_en: Walk into the shop the sign points to; do not shop the sign. Two shops pointing at each other would keep you on the street till dark.
nodes.example_zh: 含 a→b→a 目录环的树 ingest 正常终止，机制测试有环夹具。
nodes.example_en: A tree with an a→b→a cycle ingests and terminates; the cycle fixture is in the mechanism tests.
code_refs: goldmine/ingest/walk.py — 目录链不跟随与 inode 防环

dig_deeper.why_en: inode's role in the cycle guard

nodes.one_liner_zh: 摄取开始时逐根 stat——开始时就消失的根按「根失败」处理，不进删除计算
nodes.one_liner_en: Every root is stat'ed at ingest start; roots already gone are per-root failures, never deletion input
nodes.professional_zh: F10 事故教训：一个开始时就不存在的根如果不处理，会被当成「空目录」参与同步，把不该动的行当成已删除。goldmine 在 ingest 开始时对每个根 stat（pipeline.py），失败者作为 per-root failure 排除出 resolved_roots，其行不进 compute_deletions，并计入 exit-5 的按根失败报告。这是「不可读≠空」家族的第一道岗。
nodes.professional_en: The F10 lesson: a root missing at start, if unhandled, looks like an 'empty folder' and its rows read as deleted. goldmine stats every root at ingest start; failures are excluded from resolved_roots as per-root failures, their rows never enter compute_deletions, and the failure is reported in the exit-5 accounting. The first checkpoint of the 'unreadable ≠ empty' family.
nodes.plain_zh: 开工先点名：来不了的目录记「缺席」，不能当成「这个人不存在了」把他档案销毁。
nodes.plain_en: Roll call before work: an absent directory is marked absent — never pronounced dead with its records shredded.
nodes.example_zh: ingest 一个不存在的路径：退出码 5，报告列出该根的失败原因，库内无行被删。
nodes.example_en: Ingest a nonexistent path: exit 5, the root's failure listed, no rows deleted.

dig_deeper.why_zh: 被守卫保护的删除计算

nodes.one_liner_zh: 根/子树中途不可读 → 行保留 + 报告计数，绝不读成「全删了」
nodes.one_liner_en: A root or subtree that goes unreadable mid-run keeps its rows and reports the count — never reads as 'all deleted'
nodes.professional_zh: DigUp 事故 A18 的直系守卫：移动硬盘爬取中途弹出，该根「看起来空了」，sync 险些把整盘当已删除清掉。goldmine 的开始时守卫已有（phantom-roots），本节点是中途岗：compute_deletions 删减前逐根重新 stat；不可达根的行保留并在报告列出 'root unavailable, N rows kept'；子目录 OSError/PermissionError 的子树同样按不可达处理。规矩：任何新的「清行」路径都必须过 unreachable 前缀守卫。
nodes.professional_en: DigUp incident A18's direct descendant: a drive ejected mid-crawl 'looked empty' and sync nearly wiped the whole volume as deleted. goldmine's start-time guard exists (phantom-roots); this is the mid-run checkpoint: compute_deletions re-stats every root before pruning; unreachable roots keep their rows and report 'root unavailable, N rows kept'; subtrees failing with OSError/PermissionError are treated as unreachable too. House rule: any new row-pruning path must pass the unreachable-prefix guard.
nodes.plain_zh: 抽屉拉不开，不等于抽屉是空的。拉不开就整抽屉保留，贴条说明「暂不可读」——绝不当成里面什么都没有来清仓。
nodes.plain_en: A stuck drawer isn't an empty drawer. Leave it sealed, tag it 'temporarily unreadable' — never liquidate it on the assumption it held nothing.
nodes.example_zh: 机制测试用中途重命名根目录模拟拔盘：断言行仍在、报告有 kept 标记；根恢复后正常续作。
nodes.example_en: Mechanism tests rename a root mid-ingest to simulate ejection: rows survive, report shows kept; normal work resumes once restored.
code_refs: goldmine/ingest/pipeline.py — 删减前逐根重 stat
nodes.analogy_zh: 拉不开的抽屉不是空抽屉

dig_deeper.why_zh: 这条守卫是契约第 5 条

nodes.one_liner_zh: 本轮 roots 范围内、磁盘上消失的行清掉——先过不可读守卫与移动检测
nodes.one_liner_en: Rows gone from disk within this round's roots are pruned — after the unreadable and move guards
nodes.professional_zh: compute_deletions 在每轮摄取收尾运行：当前 roots_json 范围内、路径在磁盘上消失的行被清理。清删顺序是设计：先过幻影根/不可读守卫（不能把「读不到」当「已删除」），再过移动检测（路径消失但 POSIX 身份还在 = 移动不是删除）。查询期的兜底是 deleted-filter（候选阶段过滤已删文件行）——离线删除是准绳，查询期过滤是保险。
nodes.professional_en: compute_deletions closes each ingest round: rows whose paths vanished from disk within the current roots_json are pruned. The order is the design: phantom/unreachable guards run first (unreadable never reads as deleted), then move detection (path gone but POSIX identity alive = moved, not deleted). Query-time deleted-filter is the belt-and-suspenders: offline deletion is the truth, the query-time filter is the insurance.
nodes.plain_zh: 每轮收尾核对一遍「名单上的人磁盘上还在不在」。但先确认不是「门锁了」也不是「搬家了」，才准销名。
nodes.plain_en: Each round ends checking who's still on disk. But first: is the door just locked? Did they move? Only then may a name come off the list.
nodes.example_zh: 删掉一个已索引文件再 ingest：报告显示该行清理；立即 search 时若索引未更新，deleted_filtered 计数兜底。
nodes.example_en: Delete an indexed file and re-ingest: the report shows the prune; search before that shows the deleted_filtered counter catching it.
code_refs: goldmine/ingest/pipeline.py — 调用点与守卫顺序
nodes.analogy_zh: 销名之前先排除锁门和搬家
nodes.analogy_en: Rule out locked doors and moving vans first

nodes.term_zh: 边车一行 JSON 协议
nodes.one_liner_zh: stdout 上每行一个 JSON：请求 path_b64/wav_b64，回 768 维向量——简单到不会错
nodes.one_liner_en: One JSON per line on stdout: send path_b64/wav_b64, get back a 768-dim vector — too simple to get wrong
nodes.professional_zh: goldmine-embed 边车的线协议刻意原始：请求一行 JSON（path_b64 / wav_b64），响应一行 JSON（768 维向量）。配套四条血泪纪律：①stdout 是协议信道，只有 stderr 开排空线程（早期双排空线程把协议响应吃掉，请求永远等不到回包）；②裸 fd + os.read 轮询（BufferedReader 预读会吃掉 poll 的数据）；③EPIPE 吞错 + SIGPIPE 忽略；④超长坏行丢弃保活不毒连接。
nodes.professional_en: The goldmine-embed sidecar's wire protocol is deliberately primitive: one JSON line in (path_b64 / wav_b64), one JSON line out (a 768-dim vector). Four scar-tissue rules accompany it: (1) stdout is the protocol channel; only stderr gets a drain thread (an early two-drain version ate protocol responses — requests waited forever); (2) raw fd + os.read polling (BufferedReader's lookahead starves poll); (3) swallow EPIPE, ignore SIGPIPE; (4) drop oversized bad lines to keep the connection alive.
nodes.plain_zh: 和边车说话像老式电报：一行进一行出，格式简单到没法 misunderstanding。四条使用须知全是真事故换来的。
nodes.plain_en: Talking to the sidecar is telegraphy: one line in, one line out, too simple to misread. The four usage rules are all purchased with real incidents.
nodes.example_zh: tools/embed/goldmine-embed.c 头注释与 tests/ 的协议测试钉住格式；坏行注入测试验证第④条。
nodes.example_en: The C file's header and protocol tests pin the format; a bad-line injection test proves rule 4.
nodes.analogy_zh: 一行电报，四条保命规矩

nodes.one_liner_zh: --plan 只读体检 / --missing-vectors 补向量 / --failed-only 重试失败行
nodes.one_liner_en: --plan read-only checkup / --missing-vectors fill gaps / --failed-only retry failures
nodes.professional_zh: 索引维护的三段式：repair --plan 列出 stored pending/failed 状态、缺向量、chunker/extractor 变更、可用的 OCR/ASR/媒体升级与不可达来源（索引只读、不起模型）；repair --missing-vectors 原位补齐合格文本向量（保留原文、段 ID 与已有向量，需重切的在范围内重抽）；repair --failed-only 只重试存量失败文件。默认 repair 选全部候选，但绝不扫描新范围——修理不扩地盘。
nodes.professional_en: Index maintenance in three moves: repair --plan reports stored pending/failed state, missing vectors, chunker/extractor changes, available OCR/ASR/media upgrades, unreachable sources (read-only, no model start); repair --missing-vectors fills eligible stored text vectors in place (text, segment IDs and existing vectors preserved; re-chunk cases re-extract within scope); repair --failed-only retries stored failures only. Default repair selects all candidates but never scans new scope — repairs don't annex territory.
nodes.plain_zh: 体检（不动刀）、补缺口、重试失败——三件事分开设，且都不许「顺手把新文件夹也索引了」。
nodes.plain_en: Checkup (no cutting), fill gaps, retry failures — three separate moves, none of which may 'conveniently' index new folders.
nodes.example_zh: python3 -m goldmine repair --plan --db evals/eval.sqlite：只读体检，输出按类别分节。
nodes.example_en: python3 -m goldmine repair --plan --db evals/eval.sqlite — a read-only checkup, sectioned by category.
nodes.analogy_zh: 体检、补漏、返工，三张工单
nodes.analogy_en: Checkup, gap-fill, rework: three work orders

dig_deeper.why_en: Where failure state lives and how to read it

nodes.one_liner_zh: backup 先行；reindex lexical 只重建派生索引；旧程序永不写升级库
nodes.one_liner_en: backup first; reindex lexical rebuilds only derived indexes; old programs never write upgraded libraries
nodes.professional_zh: 升级流程四步：停服务 → goldmine backup 出校验过的单文件备份（保留作回滚）→ reindex lexical 升级/重建派生索引（存储原文与向量 BLOB 原样保留；只读命令不触发升级）→ 新库只给新程序写。旧写者会被围栏拒绝（old writers are fenced）；未来 schema 直接拒开。装轮 smoke 已演练 v4→v6 升级、备份、引用陈旧、未来 schema 拒绝与用旧程序恢复的全链路。
nodes.professional_en: Four steps: stop services → goldmine backup produces a verified single-file copy (kept for rollback) → reindex lexical upgrades/rebuilds derived indexes (stored originals and vector BLOBs untouched; read-only commands never trigger upgrades) → the new library is written only by new programs. Old writers are fenced; future schemas refuse to open. An installed-wheel smoke rehearsed the whole chain: v4→v6 upgrade, backup, citation staleness, future-schema refusal, and restore under the old program.
nodes.plain_zh: 升级像搬家：先公证备份（能随时搬回去），装修只动可拆装的部分（原文和向量不动），旧家具（旧程序）不许进新家乱放。
nodes.plain_en: Upgrading is moving house: notarized backup first (you can always move back), renovation touches only removable parts (originals and vectors stay), and old furniture (old programs) may not move in.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine backup --db OLD.sqlite --out pre-upgrade.sqlite：输出带校验，恢复到不同路径用旧程序只读检查。
nodes.example_en: goldmine backup --db OLD.sqlite --out pre-upgrade.sqlite — verified output; restore to a different path and inspect read-only with the old program.
nodes.analogy_zh: 公证备份、只动软装、旧程序免进
nodes.analogy_en: Notarize, renovate softly, fence out old writers

dig_deeper.why_zh: 单文件库为什么让备份这么简单
dig_deeper.why_en: Why one-file libraries make backup trivial

nodes.one_liner_zh: 常驻后端 + 心跳 socket + linger 超时自动退——搜索从秒级到亚秒
nodes.one_liner_en: Resident backend + heartbeat socket + linger timeout — search goes from seconds to sub-second
nodes.professional_zh: serve（opt-in 守护）把后端常驻：llama-server 与媒体边车一次加载反复使用，每次查询免掉模型冷启动，搜索从「每次起模型几秒」变亚秒。生命周期由心跳与 linger 超时管理：没人用就自动退出，不留僵尸后台。能力/指纹信息由静态探针合并——不起进程也能如实回答 visual_search 之类的能力问询（能力宣称先于服务、由探针派生）。
nodes.professional_en: serve (an opt-in daemon) keeps the backends resident: llama-server and the media sidecar load once and serve many, removing model cold-start from every query — seconds become sub-second. Lifecycle runs on heartbeat + linger timeout: unused, it exits itself, leaving no zombie background. Capability/fingerprint answers merge from static probes — even without the process running, questions like visual_search get truthful answers (claims derive from probes, and precede the service).
nodes.plain_zh: 请一位翻译住家里（明确要求才请），没人说话他就自己收拾走人。还没请他时你也能问「在不在」——门口的探针替他诚实作答。
nodes.plain_en: A translator moves in only when you ask; when nobody talks to him he leaves by himself. And before he moves in, the door probe answers 'is he available?' truthfully on his behalf.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine serve --db lib.sqlite 后连续 search：第二次查询起可对比亚秒时延；空闲超时后进程自行消失。
nodes.example_en: goldmine serve --db lib.sqlite, then back-to-back searches: sub-second from the second query; idle past linger, the process is gone.
code_refs: goldmine/serve.py — 心跳、linger、静态探针合并
nodes.analogy_zh: 住家翻译，闲了自走，行踪探针可查
nodes.analogy_en: A live-in translator who self-departs and is probe-reportable

dig_deeper.why_en: The two daemons' division of labor

nodes.one_liner_zh: 文件变化先攒进静默窗再统一处理，另有 6 小时全量兜底扫
nodes.one_liner_en: File changes accumulate through a quiet window before processing, with a 6-hour full sweep as the floor
nodes.professional_zh: watch 的增量节拍：文件变化事件先在静默窗口内合并（构建工具常在毫秒内连续写十几个文件，逐个处理是灾难），窗口合拢后只重做变化的文件；full_period_s=21600（6 小时）的全量兜底扫接住任何事件机制漏掉的变化。与 watch 的自适应轮询节奏、电源门控协同：忙时不烧电、闲时不失灵。
nodes.professional_en: watch's incremental tempo: change events merge inside a quiet window (build tools write a dozen files within milliseconds — handling each is a disaster); when the window closes, only changed files redo. A full sweep at full_period_s=21600 (6 hours) catches anything the event path missed. It cooperates with adaptive polling cadence and power gating: busy time doesn't burn battery, idle time doesn't go blind.
nodes.plain_zh: 快递员不会每件到就敲门：攒一窗的包裹一起送。另外每 6 小时整体巡一遍楼，保证一个不漏。
nodes.plain_en: The courier doesn't knock per parcel; the window's worth goes out together. And every 6 hours the whole building gets a sweep.
nodes.example_zh: watch 运行中落一个文件 → status 里可见 ≤90s 内可搜（R9 live 实测口径）。
nodes.example_en: Drop a file while watch runs → searchable within ≤90 s (the R9 live-measured bound).
nodes.analogy_zh: 攒一窗一起送 + 定时全楼巡
nodes.analogy_en: Batch the window; sweep the floor regularly

nodes.one_liner_zh: 增量期反复失败的文件不再无限重试——两层分账
nodes.one_liner_en: Files failing repeatedly during incremental passes stop being retried forever — accounted at two layers
nodes.professional_zh: delta 期反复失败的文件进清单，不再无限重试；全量扫时另计（环境可能已修复，给一次机会）。防的是「一颗老鼠屎坏一锅汤」：一个永远解析失败的文件不该拖住整条管线，但也不该被静默遗忘——清单是记账不是抹除，status 与失败报告永远可查。与 P1-5 反陈旧规则调和：仅「读入中途 IO 错误」保留已读段，抽取器明确拒绝的仍走现行删段。
nodes.professional_en: Files failing repeatedly during delta passes enter the list and stop being retried indefinitely; the full sweep counts separately (the environment may have healed — grant one more chance). It prevents one bad file from stalling the pipeline while refusing to silently forget it: the list is bookkeeping, not erasure, always visible in status and failure reports. Reconciled with the anti-staleness rule: only mid-read IO errors keep already-read segments; extractor-declared rejections still follow the current segment-pruning path.
nodes.plain_zh: 总考不及格的科目先挂起，不无限补考；但期总考（全量扫）再给一次机会。挂起有台账，不是除名。
nodes.plain_en: A repeatedly failing subject gets parked, not infinite retakes; the final (full sweep) grants one more attempt. Parked is on the books, not expelled.
nodes.example_zh: status --failures 能看到哪些文件在清单上、失败原因是什么。
nodes.example_en: status --failures shows which files are listed and why they failed.
nodes.analogy_en: Parked on the books, not expelled

nodes.one_liner_zh: thermal 暂停全部、内存压力 ≥2 推迟嵌 pass、电池模式限批 50 文件
nodes.one_liner_en: Thermal pauses everything; memory pressure ≥2 defers embed passes; battery mode caps batches at 50 files
nodes.professional_zh: watch 的礼貌纪律（继承 DigUp PowerPolicy 并实测迁移）：pmset 探测三态——thermal 受限暂停全部摄取；内存压力 ≥2 推迟嵌入 pass；电池模式下 delta pass ≤50 文件 + 120s 间隔。一处刻意偏离：低电量模式只报告不阻塞（goldmine 决策 H12——本地工具不该替用户做主停工）。后端加载走同一纪律：起不来不崩、记录原因、下次再试。
nodes.professional_en: watch's courtesy rules (inherited from DigUp's PowerPolicy, migrated with measurement): pmset probes three states — thermal throttling pauses all ingestion; memory pressure ≥2 defers embed passes; battery mode caps delta passes at 50 files with 120 s spacing. One deliberate deviation: low-power mode reports but does not block (goldmine decision H12 — a local tool shouldn't overrule the user's choice to keep working). Backend loading shares the discipline: fail to start without crashing, record the reason, retry next pass.
nodes.plain_zh: 电脑发烧就歇会儿、内存紧张就缓缓、用电池就小口吃——但「没电别干活」不由程序说了算，只提醒不拦着。
nodes.plain_en: Hot machine? Pause. Tight memory? Defer. On battery? Small bites. But 'battery means stop working' is the user's call — the tool nudges, it doesn't blockade.
nodes.example_zh: doctor 与 status 的心跳里能看到电源状态与当时的门控决定。
nodes.example_en: The heartbeat in doctor/status shows the power state and the gating decision it produced.
nodes.analogy_zh: 看天吃饭，但主意的最终决定权在你
nodes.analogy_en: Read the weather; the user owns the call

nodes.one_liner_zh: 四个只读工具、同一时刻一个操作 + 两个等待者、全程预算与取消
nodes.one_liner_en: Four read-only tools, one active operation with two waiters, budgets and cancellation throughout
nodes.professional_zh: MCP 服务暴露四个只读工具（search / get / context / status），产品安全铁律：不执行外部动作、不下载、不写库。并发模型刻意保守：同一时刻一个活跃操作 + 最多两个等待者——检索引擎的下游不需要并行写入面（本来也没有写入口）。每次调用带预算（token 上限）与取消语义；显式 --db PATH 绑定，SDK extra 可选精确 2.0.0。新段型接入时 _files_with_text 口径要重审（腐烂风险清单）。
nodes.professional_en: The MCP server exposes four read-only tools (search / get / context / status) under the product-safety iron rule: no external actions, no downloads, no writes. The concurrency model is deliberately conservative: one active operation plus at most two waiters — a retrieval engine's downstream needs no parallel write surface (there is no write surface). Every call carries budgets (token caps) and cancellation; --db PATH binds explicitly; the SDK extra pins exactly 2.0.0. When new segment types land, the _files_with_text census must be re-audited (rot-risk list).
nodes.plain_zh: 给 AI 助手的窗口只有一个柜台、一次办一件、排队最多俩——而且这柜台只读不写，想改库没有这条通道。
nodes.plain_en: One counter, one transaction at a time, two waiting chairs max — and the counter is read-only; there is simply no write lane.
nodes.example_zh: docs/MCP.md 是四工具的契约原文；SDK/stdio/队列/取消测试在 optional-mcp profile。
nodes.example_en: docs/MCP.md is the four-tool contract; SDK/stdio/queue/cancellation tests run in the optional-mcp profile.
nodes.analogy_zh: 只读柜台，一号位一队列
nodes.analogy_en: A read-only counter with a one-deep queue

nodes.one_liner_zh: update_roots 把每轮流过的范围记进库——A2 过滤「只管自己人」的依据
nodes.one_liner_en: update_roots records each round's walked scope — the basis for A2's 'only our own' filtering
nodes.professional_zh: 每轮摄取收尾时 update_roots 把本轮实际走过的范围合并进库（roots_json）。这份记账是查询期删文件过滤（A2）的作用域依据：只对真实摄取过的目录范围内的行做磁盘存在性检查——离线测试用假路径建库不会被误伤（无 roots_json = 不过滤的约定，动写入口径时要重审）。forget/sources remove 的排除关系也记在同一份账上，sources restore 解除后需显式 ingest 才恢复索引。
nodes.professional_en: At each round's close, update_roots merges the round's actually-walked scope into the library (roots_json). This ledger scopes the query-time deleted filter (A2): disk-existence checks apply only to rows within genuinely-ingested directories — offline tests with fake paths are untouched (the no-roots_json-no-filter convention; re-audit when touching the write path). forget/sources-remove exclusions live in the same ledger; after sources restore, an explicit ingest is needed to re-index.
nodes.plain_zh: 管家的名册记着「我实际看过哪些地方」。删文件检查只查名册内的房间——没看过的不归它管，也不能装管。
nodes.plain_en: The housekeeper's ledger lists rooms actually walked. Deleted-file checks apply only inside the ledger — rooms never visited are neither governed nor fake-governed.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine sources list 显示 roots 与排除；forget PATH --dry-run 预览不动库。
nodes.example_en: goldmine sources list shows roots and exclusions; forget PATH --dry-run previews without writing.
nodes.analogy_en: Govern only the rooms you walked

nodes.one_liner_zh: COMMIT_DIGESTS.md 四段固定：关键行 / 风险 / 不确定 / 90 秒怎么验
nodes.one_liner_en: COMMIT_DIGESTS.md, four fixed sections: key lines / risks / uncertainties / how to verify in 90 s
nodes.professional_zh: 每个提交在合并/推送前向 docs/COMMIT_DIGESTS.md 追加四段式摘要：关键行（讲了什么行，不讲故事）、每行的风险、我不确定的地方、用户 90 秒怎么亲手验证。这是所有者的第一阅读面——把「读 diff」的成本从无限（读代码）压到有限（读四段+跑一条命令）。与锚点卡配套：摘要里的「怎么验」尽量直接引用锚点命令。
nodes.professional_en: Before any merge/push, every commit appends a four-section digest to docs/COMMIT_DIGESTS.md: key lines (what changed, no stories), each line's risk, what I'm unsure about, and how the owner verifies it by hand in 90 seconds. It's the owner's first reading surface — compressing 'read the diff' from unbounded (read code) to bounded (read four sections, run one command). Paired with the anchor cards: the 'how to verify' sections cite anchor commands directly wherever possible.
nodes.plain_zh: 每个提交自带一张「给老板的一页纸」：改了啥、哪有险、哪里我没把握、你两分半怎么查。不写小说。
nodes.plain_en: Every commit ships a one-pager for the boss: what changed, where the risk is, what I'm unsure of, how to check in 90 seconds. No novellas.
nodes.example_zh: docs/COMMIT_DIGESTS.md 顶部就是历史摘要流；读三次你就有了这个仓库的风险直觉。
nodes.example_en: docs/COMMIT_DIGESTS.md is the running digest stream; three reads in, you have the repo's risk instincts.

dig_deeper.why_zh: 摘要背后必须存在的回执
dig_deeper.why_en: The receipts that must back every digest

nodes.one_liner_zh: 每周一讲、讲后复述、缺口进下一讲——已覆盖五个子系统
nodes.one_liner_en: One subsystem per week, owner recites after, gaps roll into the next lecture — five covered
nodes.professional_zh: 理解密度制度：AI 会话负责「供货」，每周一个子系统走读（搜索打分/指纹身份/摄取管线/诚实契约/双常驻进程），每讲末尾十问，所有者脱稿复述才算过关，缺口进下一讲。新子系统落地时追加新讲。这是把「理解」当成有交付物、有验收的工程任务，而不是「有问题再问」的被动等待。
nodes.professional_en: The comprehension-density institution: AI sessions supply, the owner absorbs — one subsystem per week (search scoring / fingerprint identity / ingest pipeline / the honesty contract / the twin resident processes), ten questions ending each lecture, and the owner must recite from memory to pass; gaps roll into the next lecture. New subsystems add lectures. Understanding is treated as an engineering deliverable with acceptance criteria, not a passive 'ask when confused'.
nodes.plain_zh: 每周一对一授课 + 随堂测验：学生（仓库所有者）能脱稿复述，这一讲才算教完。没讲明白的，下周接着讲。
nodes.plain_en: Weekly one-on-one with a quiz: the student (the repo's owner) must recite unaided before a lecture counts. What didn't stick comes back next week.
nodes.example_zh: docs/WALKTHROUGH-*.md 是五讲讲义；本 Learn 地图的很多节点直接从讲义挖出。
nodes.example_en: docs/WALKTHROUGH-*.md are the five lectures; many nodes in this very Learn map were mined from them.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 超过 30 分钟的测量任务在专用 git worktree 里跑——主树被覆盖也不伤测量
nodes.one_liner_en: Measurements over 30 minutes run in a dedicated git worktree — main-tree churn can't hurt them
nodes.professional_zh: 一会话一分支之外的加保：对比/测量/评测等长跑任务（>30 分钟）在专用 git worktree 执行。P2-08 的实证：主工作树在测量进行中被并发会话覆盖两次，worktree 里的测量毫发无伤。教训制度化——长跑的敌人不是失败，是「跑的时候地基被别人换了」。
nodes.professional_en: Extra insurance beyond one-session-one-branch: comparison/measurement/eval runs over 30 minutes execute in a dedicated git worktree. P2-08's evidence: the main tree was overwritten twice by concurrent sessions mid-measurement; the worktree run was unharmed. The institutionalized lesson — a long run's enemy isn't failure, it's the floor being swapped out from under it.
nodes.plain_zh: 马拉松选手跑自己的封闭赛道，不和装修队共用马路——哪怕装修队只占路十分钟也不行。
nodes.plain_en: The marathoner runs a closed course, never sharing the road with renovation crews — even a ten-minute closure is too many.
nodes.example_zh: comparison-report-001 的复现指引明确给出 worktree 路径——测量与复现同规。
nodes.example_en: comparison-report-001's repro instructions name the worktree path — measurement and reproduction follow the same rule.

dig_deeper.why_en: The other half of the same iron rule

nodes.one_liner_zh: 保留引擎原始输出/回执/逐行指标，删重复簿记与可重装副本——26G→990M
nodes.one_liner_en: Keep raw engine output, receipts, per-line metrics; drop duplicate bookkeeping and reinstallable copies — 26G→990M
nodes.professional_zh: 执行记录清理的判据是一条线：信息无损。保留：引擎原始 stdout、回执（argv/退出码）、逐行指标（可对任意新指标离线重算）。删除：重复簿记（每命令重复序列化的资源清单、重复的全库再审计快照）与可重装副本（npm 树、快照缓存）。实例 cleanup/p2-08-comparison-20261025-00{2,3,4}：26G→990M，一条真实信息未丢。清理是工程不是大扫除——每笔删除要说得出「为什么这不是信息」。
nodes.professional_en: The criterion for pruning execution records is a single line: information lossless. Keep: raw engine stdout, receipts (argv/exit codes), per-line metrics (recomputable offline against any future metric). Delete: duplicate bookkeeping (per-command re-serialized resource manifests, repeated whole-repo re-audit snapshots) and reinstallable copies (npm trees, snapshot caches). Case cleanup/p2-08-comparison-20261025-00{2,3,4}: 26G→990M with zero real information lost. Cleanup is engineering, not spring cleaning — every deletion must say why it isn't information.
nodes.plain_zh: 扔鞋盒前先立规矩：发票和原始照片留下，包装盒和说明书副本扔掉。26G 减到 990M，凭据一张不少。
nodes.plain_en: Rules before tossing shoeboxes: invoices and originals stay; packaging and spare manuals go. 26G to 990M, not one receipt missing.
nodes.example_zh: heavy-evidence/ 目录保留了逐行指标与原始 stdout——任何新指标都能离线重算，无需重跑引擎。
nodes.example_en: heavy-evidence/ keeps per-line metrics and raw stdout — any new metric recomputes offline, no engine rerun needed.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 对外每一句主张与证据同纪律：没打绿的门不写现在时
nodes.one_liner_en: Every public claim follows evidence discipline: no present tense for unmet gates
nodes.professional_zh: 营销语言与代码同等纪律：官网首页印着 12 项红门；能力表每行标注证据等级（VERIFIED 需要 全部证据，IMPLEMENTED 只是代码存在）；尚未做到的事只能以 roadmap/计划语气出现。这张 Learn 地图同样受审：每个节点的数字都要能溯源到回执。反例是行业常态——「基本通过」「接近行业水平」这类修辞在此仓库是禁语。
nodes.professional_en: Marketing language follows the same discipline as code: the homepage prints its 12 red gates; capability rows carry evidence grades (VERIFIED requires complete evidence; IMPLEMENTED means only that code exists); unfinished work appears only in roadmap/future tense. This Learn map is audited the same way — every number traces to receipts. The industry's normal rhetoric ('basically passes', 'near state-of-the-art') is banned vocabulary here.
nodes.plain_zh: 广告词按合同标准写：说出去的每个数字要能对账，没做到的事用将来时。红门挂在首页不是谦虚，是合规。
nodes.plain_en: Ad copy written to contract standard: every public number reconciles, unfinished work uses future tense. Red gates on the homepage aren't humility — they're compliance.
nodes.example_zh: 对照检验：官网「数字」区的每个卡片都在仓库有对应回执；找不到回执的数字按事故处理。
nodes.example_en: A standing audit: every card in the site's numbers section has a receipt in the repo; an unreceipted number is treated as an incident.
